a: प्रकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To do, perform, commence (used much in the same sense as कृ); जानन्नपि नरो दैवात्प्रकरोति विगर्हितं Pt. 4. 35; Ki. 4. 30, Mv. 2. 13, Bk. 2. 36; Rs. 1. 6; Ms. 8. 54, 60; 8. 230; Amaru. 13. --2 To accomplish, achieve, effect. --3 To assault, outrage, insult; Bk. 8. 19. --4 To honor, worship. --5 To express, utter. --6 To place in front, mention first. --7 To appoint (to a post, office &c.). --8 Ved. To induce. --9 To win, conquer. --10 To destroy.

paramAtmanaH । sarvvasampatsvarUpA sA tadaDizWAtfdevatA ॥ kAntA dAntA ca SAntA ca suSIlA sarvvamaNgalA । loBamohakAmarozAhaNkAraparivarjjitA ॥ BaktAnuraktA patyuSca sarvvAByaSca pativratA । prARatulyA varA ॥ sarvvasOBAgyayuktA ca mAninI gOravAnvitA । vAmArdDANgasvarUpA ca guRena tejasA samA ॥ parA varA sAraBUtA paramAdyA sanAtanI । paramAnandarUpA ca DanyA mAnyA ca pUjitA ॥ rAsakrIqADidevI ca kfzRasya paramAtmanaH । rAsamaRqalasaMBUtA rAsamaRqalamaRqitA ॥ rAseSvarI surasikA rAsavAsanivAsinI । golokavAsinI devI gopIveSaviDAyikA ॥ paramAhlAdarUpA ca santozaharzarUpiRI । nirguRA ca guRAkArA nirliptAtmasvarUpiRI ॥ nirIhA nirahaNkArA BaktAnugrahavigrahA । vedAnusAraDyAnena vijYAtA sA vicakzaREH ॥ dfzwidfzwA lasadveSA surendrErmunipuqgavEH । vahniSudDAMSukADAnA ratnAlaNkAraBUzitA ॥ kowicandrapraBAjuzwapuzwaSrIyuktavigrahA । SrIkfzRaBaktidA sEva dAtrI ca sarvvasampadAm ॥ avatAre ca vArAhe vfzaBAnusutA ca yA । yatpAdapadmasaMsparSapavitrA ca vasunDarA ॥ brahmAdiBiradfzwA yA sarvvadfzwA ca BArate । strIratnasArasaMBUtA kfzRavakzaHsTalojjvalA ॥ yaTA Gane navaGane lolA sOdAminI mune ! । zazwivarzasahasrARi prataptaM brahmaRA purA ॥ yatpAdapadmanaKaradfzwaye cAtmaSudDaye । devyaSca sarvvayozitaH ॥ paripUrRatamA paYcaviDA devI prakIrttitA । yA yAH praDAnAMSarUpA varRayAmi niSAmaya ॥” 5 ॥ gaNgA yaTA, -- “praDAnAMSasvarUpA yA gaNgA BuvanapAvanI । vizRuvigrahasaMBUtA hararUpA sanAtanI ॥ pApipApenDadAhAya jvaladinDanarUpiRI । suKasparSasnAnapAne nirvvARapadadAyinI ॥ goloke sTAnaprasTAnasuKasopAnarUpiRI । pavitrarUpA tIrTAnAM saritAYca parA varA ॥ SamBumOlijawAmerumuktApaMktisvarUpiRI । tapaHsantApinI sadyo BArate ca tapasvinAm ॥ candrapadmakzIraniBA SfRu sattvasvarUpiRI । nirmmalA nirahaNkArA sADvI nArAyaRapriyA ॥” 1 ॥ tulasI yaTA, -- “praDAnAMSasvarUpA ca tulasI vizRukAminI । vizRuBUzaRarUpA ca vizRupAdasTitA satI ॥ tapaHsaNkalpapUjAdisadyaHsampAdinI mune ! । sAraBUtA ca puzpARAM pavitrA puRyadA sadA ॥ darSanasparSanAByAYca sadyonirvvARadAyinI । kalO kaluzaSuzkeDmadAhAyAgnisvarUpiRI ॥ yatpAdapadmasaMsparSasadyaHpUtA vasunDarA । yatsparSadarSaM vAYCanti tIrTAni cAtmaSudDaye ॥ yayA vinA ca viSvezu sarvvakarmmAtinizPalam । mokzadA yA mumukzURAM kAminAM sarvvakAmadA ॥ kalpavfkzasvarUpA ca BArate brahmarUpiRI । trARAya BAratAnAYca prajAnAM paradevatA ॥” 2 ॥ manasA yaTA, -- “praDAnAMSasvarUpA yA manasA kaSyapAtmajA । SaNkarapriyaSizyA ca mahAjYAnaviSAradA ॥ nAgeSvarasyAnantasya BaginI nAgapUjitA । nAgeSvarI nAgamAtA sundarI nAgavAhinI ॥ nAgendragaRayuktA sA nAgaBUzaRaBUzitA । nAgendrErvvanditA sidDayoginI nAgaSAyinI ॥ vizRurUpA vizRuBaktA vizRupUjAparAyaRA । tapaHsvarUpA tapasAM PaladAtrI tapasvinI ॥ divyaM trilakzavarzaYca tapastaptaM yayA hareH । tapasvinIzu pUjyA ca tapasvinA ca BArate ॥ sarpamantrADidevI ca jvalantI brahmatejasA । brahmasvarUpA paramA brahmaBAvena tatparA ॥ jaratkArumuneH patnI kfzRAMSasya pativratA । AstIkasya munermmAtA pravarasya tapasvinAm ॥” 3 ॥ zazWI yaTA, -- “praDAnAMSasvarUpA yA devasenA ca nArada ! । mAtfkAsu pUjyatamA sA ca zazWI prakIrttitA ॥ SiSUnAM prativiSvezu pratipAlanakAriRI । tapasvinI vizRuBaktA kArttikeyasya kAminI । zazWAMSarUpA prakftestena zazWI prakIrttitA ॥ puttrapOttrapradAtrI ca DAtrIti jagatAM satI । sundarI yuvatI ramyA santataM Bartturantike ॥ sTAne SiSUnAM paramA vfdDarUpA ca yoginI । pUjA dvAdaSamAsezu yasyA viSvezu santatam ॥ svapnagocare ॥” 4 ॥ maNgalacaRqI yaTA, -- “praDAnAMSasvarUpA ca devI maNgalacaRqikA । prakftermuKyasaMBUtA sarvvamaNgaladA sadA ॥ sfzwO maNgalarUpA ca saMhare koparUpiRI । tena maNgalacaRqI sA paRqitEH parikIrttitA ॥ pratimaNgalavArezu prativiSvezu vanditA । paYcopacArEryozidBirBaktyA ca paripUjitA ॥ puttrapOttraDanESvaryyayaSomaNgaladAyinI । lokasantApapApArttiduHKadAridranASinI ॥
